svg.text: Every grid square is scaled by the same factor, so any region's area is multiplied by it — that factor is the determinant.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans SC', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Zero means space is flattened (linearly dependent columns); negative means orientation flipped, with the absolute value still the factor.
